gloss: sake lees pickle; pickled in sake lees

definitions.gloss: sake lees pickle; pickled in sake lees
definitions.explanation: food preserved in sake kasu (the solid residue from sake brewing)

examples.japanese: {粕漬|かすづ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: I grilled fish pickled in sake lees.

examples.japanese: {粕漬|かすづ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Sake lees pickles have a nice flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粕漬|かすづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I bought some daikon pickled in sake lees.

notes:
USAGE:
{粕漬|かすづ}け is made by packing fish or vegetables in ⟦{酒粕|さけかす}→酒粕：14773_sakekasu⟧, the solid residue left after pressing sake. The result is sweet and savory with a faint alcoholic aroma. Fish kasuzuke is usually grilled; watch it closely, as the lees burn easily.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粕漬|かすづ}け (fish pickled in sake lees)
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粕漬|かすづ}け (vegetables in sake lees)
- {奈良漬|ならづ}け (a famous vegetable kasuzuke, usually gourd)

WATCH OUT:
{西京漬|さいきょうづ}け, often sold next to fish kasuzuke, is made with sweet white miso, not sake lees.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{酒粕|さけかす}→酒粕：14773_sakekasu⟧ (sake lees)
- ⟦{酢漬|すづ}け→酢漬け：08229_suzuke⟧ (vinegar pickle)
- ⟦{味噌漬|みそづ}け→味噌漬け：24781_misozuke⟧ (miso pickle)
